english: Point to each apple once: one, two, three.

english: Point to each apple once: one, two, three. Two apples and one more make three.

english: This device has no English voice yet. Read the word and keep going.

english: Useful English for everyday life, curious minds and kind hearts.

pashto: وګورئ ← واورئ ← ګډون وکړئ ← لوبه ← تکرار
english: Watch → Listen → Join in → Play → Review

pashto: وګورئ او واورئ. بیا په جواب ګوته کېږدئ. که نه پوهېږئ، مدد وغواړئ او بیا کوشش وکړئ.
english: Watch and listen. Then tap an answer. You can ask for a hint and try again.

pashto: کتل یوه خبره معرفي کوي. ستاسو ځوابونه ښيي چې په څه پوه شوې. بیا کتل تل ښه دي.
english: Watching introduces an idea. Your answers show what you understand. Revisiting is always welcome.

pashto: موږ اندازه پرتله کولی شو. فیل له موږک نه لوی دی. موږک له فیل نه وړوکی دی.
english: We can compare size. An elephant is bigger than a mouse. A mouse is smaller than an elephant.

pashto: موږ په وار وار کار کولی شو. Please، thank you او excuse me د ادب ګټور لفظونه دي. د پور اخیستو نه مخکې پوښتنه کوو.
english: We can take turns. Please, thank you and excuse me are useful polite words. We can ask before borrowing.

pashto: دوه شیان په -er + than یا more + than پرتله کوو. په ډله کې د تر ټولو د پاره the + -est یا the most کاروو.
english: We compare two things with -er + than or more + than. We use the + -est or the most for the top one in a group.
We say hello when we meet.

pashto: د ختم شویو کارونو د پاره past simple کاروو. عادي فعلونو ته -ed ورزیاتېږي: play → played. ځینې فعلونه بدلېږي: go → went، see → saw، eat → ate.
english: We use the past simple for finished actions. Regular verbs add -ed: play → played. Some verbs are irregular: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate.

pashto: د ټکي د شکل د مشق د پاره څه کولی شئ؟
english: What can you do to practise a letter shape?

pashto: د لمر په ورځ اسمان څه رنګ وي؟ ☀️
english: What colour is the sunny sky? ☀️

pashto: له ورېځو نه راپرېوتو اوبو ته څه وایو؟
english: What do we call water falling from clouds?
What do we use to wash our hands?

pashto: څه ګورې؟ په تصویر کې یو شي ته ګوته ونیسئ او نوم یې ووایئ.
english: What do you notice? Point to something in the scene and say its name.

pashto: هغه په کاسه کې څه اچوي؟
english: What does she put in the bowl?

pashto: وروسته به څه کېږي؟ خپل فکر ووایئ، بیا پاڼه واړوئ.
english: What might happen next? Share your idea, then turn the page.

pashto: چې څوک درسره مدد وکړي، ووایئ “Thank you” (مننه).
english: When someone helps you, say “Thank you.”

pashto: چې موږ سټېشن ته ورسېدو، رېل ګاډی ___ .
english: When we reached the station, the train ___.
Where does the star want to go?

pashto: د Monday (ګل) نه وروسته کومه ورځ راځي؟
cat په کوم ټکي شروع کېږي؟
د دې څاروي نوم کوم لفظ دی؟ 🐈
څوک؟ I (زه). زه څه خوښوم؟ Apples (مڼې).
english: Who? I. What do I like? Apples.

pashto: په سفر کې ورک شوی یې. یو باوري مشر ته څه ووایئ؟
english: You are lost while travelling. What can you say to a safe adult?

pashto: اوس ته A، B او C پېژنې!
english: You can recognize A, B and C!

pashto: په دوکان کې خپل مشر نه شئ پیدا کولی. څه باید وکړې؟
english: You cannot find your grown-up in a shop. What should you do?

pashto: تاسو وکړل! هر ګام ارزښت لري.
english: You did it! Every step counts.
You found it! Your practice helped.

pashto: د لوستلو د پاره یې خلاصوې.
تاسو لوبه وکړه، کوشش دې وکړ او زده دې کړل!

english: You reached the end of the path!

pashto: تاسو خپل لومړی انګرېزي لفظ وویل: Hello! (سلام)
english: You said your first English word: Hello!

pashto: په دوکان کې مڼه غواړئ. ته څه ویلی شئ؟
english: You want an apple in a shop. What can you say?

pashto: په دوکان کې مدد غواړئ. ته څه ویلی شئ؟
english: You want help in a shop. What can you say?

pashto: پنسل په پور غواړئ. ته څه ویلی شئ؟
english: You want to borrow a pencil. What can you say?

pashto: ته یې کولی شئ، وړوکي سیلانیه!
ستاسو لومړی نښان د “له نویو ملګرو سره وپېژنئ” وروسته دی.
english: Your first badge is waiting after “Meet your new friends”.

pashto: ستاسو لومړی وړوکی لفظ ستاسو انتظار کوي.
english: Your first little word is waiting for you.

pashto: ستاسو بل سفر له دې ځایه پیلېږي.
له لوبې وروسته به دې ازموینې دلته ښکاره شي.
english: Your quizzes will appear here after you play.

pashto: ___ هغه ستړی وو، خپل کار یې پوره کړ.
english: ___ he was tired, he finished his work.
___ you see the moon last night?

pashto: استاذ راته وویل: “دروازه بنده کړئ.” → استاذ راته وویل چې دروازه ___.
english: “Close the door,” the teacher told me. → The teacher told me ___ the door.

pashto: هغې وپوښتل: “چای خوښوې؟” → هغې وپوښتل چې ایا زه چای ___.
english: “Do you like tea?” she asked. → She asked if I ___ tea.

pashto: علي وویل: “زه خوشاله یم.” → علي وویل چې هغه ___ خوشاله.
english: “I am happy,” said Ali. → Ali said that he ___ happy.

pashto: سارا وویل: “زه ستړې یم.” → سارا وویل چې ستړې وه. زمانه معمولاً یو ګام شاته ځي.
english: “I am tired,” said Sara. → Sara said that she was tired. Tenses usually move one step back.

pashto: “زه ستړې یم.” → هغې وویل چې ستړې وه.
english: “I am tired.” → She said (that) she was tired.

pashto: سارا وویل: “زه چای خوښوم.” کوم بیان سم دی؟
english: “I like tea,” said Sara. Which report is correct?

pashto: “زه به مدد وکړم.” → هغه وویل چې مدد به وکړي.
english: “I will help.” → He said he would help.

pashto: “It’s a piece of cake” یعنې ډېر اسان دی. “Give up” یعنې کوشش پرېښودل.
english: “It’s a piece of cake” means it is very easy. “Give up” means stop trying.

pashto: دوی وویل: “موږ به راشو.” → دوی وویل چې ___ راشي.
english: “We will come,” they said. → They said that they ___ come.

pashto: “کله چې زه سټېشن ته ورسېدم، رېل ګاډی ___.”
english: “When I got to the station, the train ___.”

pashto: پیشو لویه ده. آس تر هغې لوی دی. فیل تر ټولو لوی دی.
english: A cat is big. A horse is bigger. An elephant is the biggest.

pashto: باورچي کس دی، نو who وکاروئ.
english: A chef is a person, so use who.

pashto: ډاکټر هغه کس دی چې له ناروغانو سره مدد کوي. پېښور هغه ښار دی چې زه پکې زېږېدلی یم.
english: A doctor is a person who helps sick people. Peshawar is the city where I was born.

pashto: په تېر وخت کې اوږد کار: was/were + -ing.
english: A longer action in the past: was/were + -ing.

pashto: تېر کار چې پایله یې اوس ده: present perfect.
english: A past action with a result now: present perfect.

pashto: a piece of cake = ډېر اسان.
english: A piece of cake = very easy.

pashto: a piece of cake = ډېر اسان. under the weather = لږ ناجوړه.
english: A piece of cake = very easy. Under the weather = a bit ill.

pashto: پیلوټ هغه کس دی چې جهاز چلوي.
english: A pilot is a person who flies planes.

pashto: مخکې جوړ شوی پلان going to کاروي.
english: A plan made before uses going to.

pashto: پوښتنه په Are you شروع کېږي.
english: A question starts with Are you.

pashto: ریښتینی امکان: if + اوسنی، will + فعل.
english: A real possibility: If + present, will + verb.

pashto: رېل ګاډی له بس نه چټک دی.
english: A train is faster than a bus.

pashto: active: خلک په سوات کې وریژې کري. passive: په سوات کې وریژې کرل کېږي. active: یو چا پل جوړ کړ. passive: پل په 1990 کې جوړ شو.
english: Active: People grow rice in Swat. Passive: Rice is grown in Swat. Active: Someone built the bridge. Passive: The bridge was built in 1990.

pashto: by + کس یوازې هغه وخت ورزیات کړه چې مهم وي: کتاب د سارا لخوا لیکل شوی.
english: Add by + person only if it is important: The book was written by Sara.

pashto: مشوره: که زه ستاسو پر ځای وای، بښنه به مې غوښتې وه.
english: Advice: If I were you, I would apologise.

pashto: د modal نه وروسته اصلي فعل راځي: She should go (نه: she should goes).
english: After a modal, use the base verb: She should go (not: she should goes).

pashto: علي او سارا پارک ته ځي.
english: Ali and Sara go to the park.

pashto: علي له خپل ورور نه اوږد دی.
english: Ali is taller than his brother.
Ali said that he was hungry.

pashto: علي خپل لاسونه په صابون او اوبو وینځي.
english: Ali washes his hands with soap and water.

pashto: already، yet، just: I have already finished (ما مخکې پوره کړ). Have you finished yet? (تاسو لا پوره کړ؟)
english: Already, yet, just: I have already finished. Have you finished yet?

pashto: نور ګټور: however، first، then، finally.
english: Also useful: however, first, then, finally.

pashto: که څه هم ازموینه ګرانه وه، زه کامیاب شوم.
english: Although the test was hard, I passed.
An elephant is ___ than a dog.

pashto: په اوو بجو زما مور چای جوړول.
english: At seven o’clock, my mother was making tea.

pashto: سبا همدا وخت به زه دوبۍ ته په الوتلو یم.
english: At this time tomorrow, I will be flying to Dubai.

pashto: اواز نشته. له مشر نه وغواړئ چې لفظ درته ولولي:
english: Audio is unavailable. Ask a grown-up to read the word:

pashto: امر مه کوئ؛ please او thank you ورزیات کړئ.
english: Avoid commands; add please and thank you.

pashto: د شاته کار: لمر ځلېده او مرغانو سندرې ویلې.
english: Background action: The sun was shining and the birds were singing.

pashto: bad بې قاعدې دی: bad → worse → worst.
english: Bad is irregular: bad → worse → worst.

pashto: because = دلیل: زه کور کې پاتې شوم ځکه چې ناجوړه وم.
english: Because = reason: I stayed home because I was ill.

pashto: break the ice = دوستانه خبرې پیل کول.
english: Break the ice = start a friendly conversation.

pashto: but / although = توپیر: که څه هم ناوخته وو، موږ کار ته دوام ورکړ.
english: But / although = contrast: Although it was late, we kept working.

pashto: تر څو چې موږ ورسېدو، فلم ___ .
english: By the time we arrived, the film ___ .

pashto: معلومولی شئ چې رېل ګاډی کله ځي؟
english: Can you find out when the train leaves?

pashto: I په she او like په liked بدل کړئ.
english: Change I → she and like → liked.

pashto: سم لفظ وټاکئ: “باورچي هغه کس دی ___ خواړه پخوي.”
english: Choose the right word: “A chef is a person ___ cooks food.”

pashto: امرونه: “کېنئ.” → استاذ موږ ته وویل چې کېنو.
english: Commands: “Sit down.” → The teacher told us to sit down.

pashto: kit او kite واورئ. د منځ اواز یې یو شان نه دی.
english: Compare kit and kite. Listen to the vowel.

pashto: دوه شیان په -er + than پرتله کړئ.
توپیر او پایله: On the other hand… / Therefore… / To sum up…
english: Contrast and conclusion: On the other hand… / Therefore… / To sum up…

pashto: Could I… please? په ادب دی.
مهرباني وکړئ، په دې پوښتنه کې زما مدد کولی شئ؟
english: Could you help me with this question, please?

pashto: ګرانې مېرمن خانې، زه د سکول د سفر په اړه پوښتنې د پاره لیکم.
english: Dear Ms Khan, I am writing to ask about the school trip.
Did you watch the match last night?

pashto: لاس مه اخله. ته نږدې رسېدلی یې!
english: Don’t give up. You are almost there!

pashto: مه خفه کېږئ. زه به درسره مدد وکړم.
english: Don’t worry. I will help you.

pashto: په تېر وخت کې eat په ate بدلېږي.
english: Eat changes to ate in the past.

pashto: تجربه: ایا ته کله کراچۍ ته تللی یې؟
english: Experience: Have you ever been to Karachi?

pashto: هغه حقیقتونه چې تل ریښتیا وي اوسنی + اوسنی کاروي.
english: Facts that are always true use present + present.

pashto: fast لنډ دی، نو -er + than ورزیات کړئ.
english: Fast is short, so add -er + than.

pashto: first: که باران وشي، موږ به دننه پاتې شو. (ریښتینی امکان)
english: First: If it rains, we will stay inside. (real possibility)

pashto: فټبال په ټوله نړۍ کې لوبول کېږي.
english: Football is played all over the world.

pashto: for + د وخت اوږدوالی (for two years)؛ since + د پیل وخت (since 2020).
english: For + length of time (for two years); since + starting point (since 2020).

pashto: for instance = for example (د بېلګې په توګه).
جوړښت: be + past participle: is made، was built، will be opened.
english: Form: be + past participle: is made, was built, will be opened.

pashto: جوړښت: have/has + past participle: I have seen، she has gone.
english: Form: have/has + past participle: I have seen, she has gone.

pashto: جوړښت: was/were + -ing: I was reading (ما لوستل). They were playing (دوی لوبې کولې).
english: Form: was/were + -ing: I was reading. They were playing.

pashto: رسمي برېښنالیک: Dear Mr Ahmed, / I am writing to… / Kind regards,
english: Formal email: Dear Mr Ahmed, / I am writing to… / Kind regards,

pashto: رسمي لیکونه په Dear + نوم شروع کېږي.
english: Formal letters start with Dear + name.

pashto: future continuous: په راتلونکي وخت کې روان کار.
english: Future continuous: an action in progress at a future time.

pashto: future continuous: will be + -ing، په راتلونکي کې د روان کار د پاره.
english: Future continuous: will be + -ing, for an action in progress at a future time.

pashto: په This is because… دلیل ووایئ
english: Give a reason with This is because…

pashto: give up = کوشش پرېښودل. look after = پاملرنه کول. find out = موندل.
english: Give up = stop trying. Look after = take care of. Find out = discover.

pashto: go بې قاعدې دی. تېر شکل یې went دی.
english: Go is irregular. Its past form is went.

pashto: have + past participle د تجربو خبرې کوي.
english: Have + past participle talks about experiences.

pashto: have + past participle: see → saw → seen.
english: Have + past participle: see → saw → seen.

pashto: ایا تاسو کله د ملتان آمونه خوړلي؟
english: Have you ever eaten mangoes from Multan?

pashto: هغه ستوري ته د کور لاره ښيي.
english: He helps the star find its way home.

pashto: هغه مڼې د خپل کور د خلکو سره وېشي.
english: He shares the apples with his family.

pashto: هغه ټوکه وکړه چې خبرې پیل شي.
english: He told a joke to break the ice.

pashto: he، she او it سره has راځي.
english: He, she and it use has.

pashto: استاذ ته رسمي برېښنالیک څنګه پیل شي؟
english: How should a formal email to a teacher start?

pashto: ما د شپې ډوډۍ ___ چې ټیلیفون زنګ وواهه.
english: I ___ dinner when the phone rang.

pashto: ما خپلې کیلي ___. دروازه نه شم خلاصولی.
english: I ___ my keys. I can’t open the door.

pashto: زه به بله اونۍ اسلام اباد ته ځم.
english: I am going to visit Islamabad next week.
I am writing an essay at the moment.

pashto: ما دا فلم درې ځله ___ دی.
english: I have ___ this film three times.

pashto: ما هېڅکله سمندر نه دی لیدلی.
english: I have never seen the sea.

pashto: زه سوات ته تللی یم. هغې هېڅکله واوره نه ده لیدلې. ایا ته کله په جهاز کې الوتلی یې؟
english: I have visited Swat. She has never seen snow. Have you ever flown in a plane?

pashto: زه لوستل خوښوم ځکه چې ارام راکوي.
english: I like reading because it is relaxing.

pashto: زه چای خوښوم، ___ زما ورور جوس خوښوي.
english: I like tea, ___ my brother likes juice.

pashto: هغه قلم مې ورک کړ چې تاسو راکړی وو.
english: I lost the pen which you gave me.

pashto: کېدی شي دا اونۍ پای ته خپلو د تره زامنو ته ورشم.
english: I might visit my cousins this weekend.

pashto: زه پوره باور لرم چې هر ماشوم باید لامبو زده کړي.
english: I strongly believe that every child should learn to swim.

pashto: ما غوښتل لوبه وکړم. خو باران ورېده.
english: I wanted to play. However, it was raining.

pashto: ما کورنی کار کاوه چې بجلي لاړه.
english: I was doing my homework when the lights went out.

pashto: زه ستړی وم، نو ویده شوم. زه کور کې پاتې شوم ځکه چې باران ورېده.
english: I was tired, so I went to bed. I stayed home because it was raining.

pashto: زه کور ته روان وم چې باران پیل شو. کله چې علي لوستل، خور یې پخلی کاوه.
english: I was walking home when it started to rain. While Ali was reading, his sister was cooking.
I wore a coat ___ it was cold.

pashto: زه under the weather یم. زه … احساس کوم
english: I’m feeling under the weather. I feel…

pashto: زه تږی یم. لږ اوبه به راوړم.
english: I’m thirsty. I will get some water.

pashto: که ما سره یو ملیون روپۍ ___، سکول به مې جوړ کړی وای.
english: If I ___ a million rupees, I would build a school.

pashto: که وختي فارغ شوم، زنګ به درته ووهم.
english: If I finish early, I will call you.

pashto: که زه مشر استاذ وای، کتابتون به مې جوړ کړی وای.
english: If I were the head teacher, I would build a library.

pashto: که زه ستاسو پر ځای وای، ډاکټر ته به ___.
english: If I were you, I ___ to the doctor.

pashto: If I were you… له would سره مشوره ورکوي.
english: If I were you… gives advice with would.

pashto: که سبا باران وشي، موږ به په کور کې ___.
english: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.

pashto: که نیلي او زېړ ګډ کړې، شین جوړېږي.
english: If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.

pashto: خیالي حالتونه: if + تېر، would + فعل.
english: Imaginary situations: If + past, would + verb.

pashto: عادي پیغام: Hi Sara! / Thanks a lot! / See you soon!
english: Informal message: Hi Sara! / Thanks a lot! / See you soon!

pashto: عادي: قلم راکړئ. په ادب: مهرباني وکړئ قلم راکړې؟ رسمي برېښنالیک: غواړم پوښتنه وکړم د…
english: Informal: Give me the pen. Polite: Could you pass me the pen, please? Formal email: I would like to ask about…

pashto: پرې شوی کار: زه کور ته روان وم چې یو زوړ ملګری مې ولید.
english: Interrupted action: I was walking home when I saw an old friend.

pashto: بې قاعدې فعلونه: go → went، have → had، see → saw، eat → ate، come → came.
english: Irregular verbs: go → went, have → had, see → saw, eat → ate, come → came.

pashto: بې قاعدې: good → better → the best؛ bad → worse → the worst.
english: Irregular: good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst.
It makes a new meeting feel less awkward.

pashto: باران ورېده، ___ موږ دننه لوبې وکړې.
english: It was raining, ___ we played inside.

pashto: اوازونه سره یو ځای کړئ او لفظ ووایئ.
english: Join the sounds and say the word.

pashto: Kind regards په ادب او رسمي دی.
english: Kind regards is polite and formal.
Last week we ___ to the river.

pashto: محاورې په بېلګو جملو کې زده کړئ، نه د لړ په توګه.
english: Learn idioms in example sentences, not as a list.

pashto: د sun، cup او bus اوازونه واورئ.
english: Listen to sun, cup and bus.

pashto: په bed او pen کې د منځ اواز واورئ.
english: Listen to the middle sound in bed and pen.

pashto: د v او w اوازونه واورئ. خپلو شونډو ته پام کوئ.
english: Listen to v and w. Watch your lips.

pashto: په ship کې د منځ اواز لنډ دی، په sheep کې اوږد دی.
english: Listen: ship is short; sheep is longer.

pashto: اوږدې صفتونه: beautiful → more beautiful → the most beautiful.
english: Long adjectives: beautiful → more beautiful → the most beautiful.

pashto: -ed او د yesterday لفظ ته وګورئ.
english: Look for -ed and the word yesterday.

pashto: نښې لفظونه ولټوئ: yesterday → past simple؛ already/ever → present perfect؛ now → present continuous؛ next year → future.
english: Look for clue words: yesterday → past simple; already/ever → present perfect; now → present continuous; next year → future.

pashto: وګورئ! ماشومان اوس په باغ کې ___.
english: Look! The children ___ in the garden now.

pashto: might / could: کېدی شي نن شپه واوره وورېږي.
english: Might / could: It might snow tonight.

pashto: might یعنې ممکن دی، یقیني نه دی.
english: Might means it is possible, not certain.

pashto: ماونټ ایورسټ په نړۍ کې تر ټولو ___ غر دی.
english: Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.

pashto: must / mustn’t: هلمټ حتمي واغوندئ. په سور څراغ مه تېرېږئ.
english: Must / mustn’t: You must wear a helmet. You mustn’t cross on red.

pashto: must د سختو قوانینو د پاره دی.

english: Mustn’t means it is not allowed.

pashto: مور مې راته وویل چې کورنی کار پوره کړم.
english: My mother told me to finish my homework.

pashto: زما ازموینه خرابه وه، خو ستاسو ___ وه.
english: My test was bad, but yours was ___.

pashto: هېڅکله give up مه کوئ! مانا یې ده…

english: Now + an action in progress: am/is/are + -ing.

pashto: اوس د هغه لاسونه پاک دي.
له بلې خوا، ځینې خلک وایي چې ګران دی.
english: On the other hand, some people say it is expensive.

pashto: خوله خلاصه کړئ او شونډې ګردې کړئ.
english: Open your mouth and round your lips.

pashto: د لنډ a اواز د پاره خوله خلاصه کړئ.
english: Open your mouth for the short a sound.

pashto: نظر: زما په نظر ماشومان باید هره ورځ ولولي. دلیل: ځکه چې لوستل لفظونه زیاتوي. بېلګه: د بېلګې په توګه، قیصې نوي لفظونه ښيي.
english: Opinion: In my opinion, children should read every day. Reason: This is because reading builds vocabulary. Example: For example, stories teach new words.

pashto: نظر: In my opinion… / I strongly believe that…
english: Opinion: In my opinion… / I strongly believe that…

pashto: د past continuous پوښتنې: What were you doing?
english: Past continuous questions: What were you doing?

pashto: past perfect: had + past participle، د دوو تېرو کارونو د لومړي د پاره.
english: Past perfect: had + past participle, for the earlier of two past actions.

pashto: past perfect: یو کار د بل تېر کار نه مخکې شوی.
english: Past perfect: something happened before another past action.

pashto: تېر: پل په 1990 کې جوړ شو.
english: Past: The bridge was built in 1990.

pashto: پلان: زه به نن شپه درس ووایم.
english: Plan: I am going to study tonight.

pashto: پلان: زه به نیا ته ورځم. ژره پرېکړه: یخ دی. کړکۍ به بنده کړم.
english: Plan: I am going to visit my grandmother. Quick decision: It is cold. I will close the window.

pashto: مهرباني وکړئ د خپل کشر ورور look after وکړئ. look after مانا ده…
english: Please look after your little brother. Look after means…

pashto: مهرباني وکړئ، خپل کتاب خلاص کړئ.
د ادب غوښتنې: Could you…? Would you mind…ing? May I…?
english: Polite requests: Could you…? Would you mind…ing? May I…?

pashto: present continuous: now، at the moment (اوس).
english: Present continuous: now, at the moment.

pashto: present perfect: ever، never، already، yet، since، for.
english: Present perfect: ever, never, already, yet, since, for.

pashto: اوسنی: په سوات کې وریژې کرل کېږي.
english: Present: Rice is grown in Swat.

pashto: ژمنه یا اټکل: زه به درسره مدد وکړم. لمر به وي.
english: Promise or prediction: I will help you. It will be sunny.

pashto: شونډې لږې مخې ته کړئ او هوا وباسئ.
english: Push your lips forward and let air out.

pashto: د ژبې سر د غاښونو منځ کې لږ کېږدئ.
english: Put your tongue gently between your teeth.

pashto: د تېر وخت پوښتنې په Did شروع کېږي.
english: Questions about the past use Did.

pashto: پوښتنې او منفي جملې did + اصلي فعل کاروي: Did you go? I didn’t go.
english: Questions and negatives use did + base verb: Did you go? I didn’t go.

pashto: پوښتنې: “چېرته اوسېږې؟” → هغې وپوښتل چې زه چېرته اوسېږم.
english: Questions: “Where do you live?” → She asked where I lived.

pashto: ژره پرېکړه: ټیلیفون زنګ وهي. زه به یې ځواب کړم.
english: Quick decision: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.

pashto: ریښتینی راتلونکی: که باران وشي، دننه به پاتې شو. خیالي: که زه مرغه وای، د غرونو له پاسه به الوتم.
english: Real future: If it rains, we will stay inside. Imaginary: If I were a bird, I would fly over the mountains.

pashto: دلیل: This is because… / The main reason is…
english: Reason: This is because… / The main reason is…

pashto: عادي فعلونه: walk → walked، play → played، watch → watched.
english: Regular verbs: walk → walked, play → played, watch → watched.

pashto: بیان شوي امرونه told + کس + to + فعل کاروي.
english: Reported commands use told + person + to + verb.

pashto: بیان شوې پوښتنې if کاروي او زمانه شاته وړي.
english: Reported questions use if and move the tense back.

pashto: اوازونه ووایئ، بیا یې سره یو ځای کړئ.
english: Say the sounds, then join them.

pashto: second: که زما وزرونه وای، الوتلی به وم. (خیالي)
english: Second: If I had wings, I would fly. (imaginary)

pashto: هغې پرون له سکول وروسته یوه مڼه ___.
english: She ___ an apple after school yesterday.

pashto: هغې خپل کورنی کار مخکې ___ پوره کړی.
هغې وپوښتل چې ایا زه کرکټ خوښوم.
english: She asked me if I liked cricket.

pashto: هغې نن سهار ناشته ونه کړه.
english: She didn’t eat breakfast this morning.

pashto: هغې پروژه مخکې پوره کړې ده.
english: She has already finished the project.

pashto: هغه له 2018 راهیسې په مینګوره کې اوسېږي.
english: She has lived in Mingora since 2018.

pashto: دا هغه نجلۍ ده چې خور یې ډاکټره ده.
english: She is the girl whose sister is a doctor.

pashto: هغه په خپل بکس کې کتاب ږدي.
english: She puts a book in her bag.

pashto: هغه په پیاله کې اوبه اچوي.
english: She puts water in a bowl.

pashto: لنډې صفتونه: tall → taller → the tallest.
english: Short adjectives: tall → taller → the tallest.

pashto: should / shouldn’t: ته باید وختي ویده شئ.
english: Should / shouldn’t: You should sleep early.

pashto: should د مشورې د پاره کارېږي.
since + د پیل وخت. for + د وخت اوږدوالی.
english: Since + a starting point. For + a length of time.

pashto: so = پایله: ناجوړه وم، نو کور کې پاتې شوم.
english: So = result: I was ill, so I stayed home.

pashto: so وایي چې بیا څه وشول.
english: So tells us what happened next.

pashto: په In my opinion, پیل کړئ
په We will شروع کړئ، بیا کار.
english: Start with We will, then the action.

pashto: هوا لږه بنده کړئ، بیا یې پرېږده.
english: Stop the air, then release it.

pashto: زده کوونکي ___ په بس کې د څوکۍ کمربند وتړي. دا قانون دی.
english: Students ___ wear a seatbelt on the bus. It is the rule.

pashto: خپل فکر په For example, سره پیاوړی کړئ
english: Support your idea with For example,

pashto: سوات هغه دره ده چې ډېر سیلانیان ورځي.
english: Swat is a valley where many tourists go.
Take an umbrella. It ___ rain later.

pashto: ستاسو د مدد مننه. په درناوي، علي.
english: Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Ali.
The book is on the chair.

pashto: بس ناوخته شو، نو موږ پلي لاړو.
english: The bus was late, so we walked.
The cat is in the box.
The cat is on the chair.

pashto: ډاکټر وویل چې باید ارام وکړم.
english: The doctor said that I should rest.
The exam was a piece of cake.
The fox sees a little star.

pashto: په cape کې اخري e نه وایو. د a اواز ته غوږ ونیسئ.
english: The last e is silent in cape. Listen to the change.

pashto: اصلي دلیل دا دی چې موږ خوندي ساتي.
english: The main reason is that it keeps us safe.
The new hospital was opened last year.
The results will be announced tomorrow.

pashto: هغه لنډ کار چې منځ کې راځي past simple کاروي.
english: The short action that interrupts uses the past simple.

pashto: ازموینه a piece of cake وه. ازموینه … وه
english: The test was a piece of cake. The test was…

pashto: رېل ګاډی زما له رسېدو مخکې تللی وو: past perfect.
english: The train left before I arrived: past perfect.

pashto: پرون په څلورو بجو دوی کرکټ ___.
english: They ___ cricket at four o’clock yesterday.

pashto: دا په سوات کې تر ټولو ښکلې دره ده.
english: This is the most beautiful valley in Swat.

pashto: دا شعر رحمان بابا لیکلی دی.
english: This poem was written by Rahman Baba.

pashto: دا قیصه له هغې نه ___ ده.
english: This story is ___ than that one.

pashto: بل کال همدا وخت به زه په پوهنتون کې ___.
english: This time next year, I ___ at university.

pashto: په لنډه توګه، ګټې یې له لګښت نه زیاتې دي.
english: To sum up, the benefits are greater than the costs.

pashto: نن زه لوبه کوم (play). پرون ما لوبه وکړه (played). ځینې فعلونه بدلېږي: go → went، eat → ate.
english: Today I play. Yesterday I played. Some verbs change: go → went, eat → ate.

pashto: نن له پرون نه ښه دی.
کله کله دوه ټکي یو اواز ورکوي.
english: Two letters can make one sound.
Under the weather = a bit ill.

pashto: په ډله کې د تر ټولو د پاره the + -est وکاروئ.
english: Use the + -est for the top one in a group.

pashto: ژبه همداسې وساتئ او اواز وباسئ.
english: Use your voice with the same tongue position.
Was + -ing shows an action in progress.

pashto: موږ به د جمعې په ورځ مېله کوو.
english: We are going to have a picnic on Friday.

pashto: نه پوهېږو چا کړی، نو passive کاروو.
english: We don’t know who did it, so we use the passive.

pashto: موږ همدا اوس خپله پروژه پوره کړه.
english: We have just finished our project.

pashto: موږ باید د خوندیتوب قوانینو ته غوږ ونیسو.
english: We must listen to the safety rules.

pashto: موږ د اتوار په ورځ بازار ته لاړو.
english: We went to the market on Sunday.

pashto: تېره شپه د اتو بجو ته څه ___ کول؟
english: What ___ you doing at 8 pm last night?

pashto: کله چې ما زنګ وواهه، ته څه کول؟
english: What were you doing when I called?

pashto: که بټوه دې پیدا کړې، څه به دې کړي وای؟
english: What would you do if you found a wallet?

pashto: کله چې موږ ورسېدو، رېل ګاډی تللی وو.
english: When we arrived, the train had left.

pashto: where → ځایونه: دا هغه سکول دی چې زما پلار پکې لوستي وو.
english: Where → places: This is the school where my father studied.

pashto: where د ځایونو د پاره دی.
which / that → شیان: هغه ټیلیفون چې ما واخیست نوی دی.
english: Which / that → things: The phone which I bought is new.

pashto: which د شیانو د پاره دی.
کومه غوښتنه تر ټولو په ادب ده؟
english: Which request is the most polite?

pashto: کومه جمله د ژوند تجربه بیانوي؟
english: Which sentence describes a life experience?

pashto: کومه جمله په تېر وخت کې روان کار بیانوي؟
english: Which sentence describes an action in progress in the past?

pashto: کومه جمله د تېر وخت په اړه ده؟
english: Which sentence is about the past?

pashto: while + روان کار: کله چې ما پخلی کاوه، هغه مېز برابر کړ.
english: While + continuous: While I was cooking, he set the table.

pashto: کله چې هغه ویده وه، پیشو پۍ ___.
english: While she was sleeping, the cat ___ the milk.

pashto: کله چې موږ روان وو، باران پیل شو.
english: While we were walking, it started to rain.

pashto: who → خلک: هغه استاذ چې زما مدد یې وکړه مهربان دی.
english: Who → people: The teacher who helped me is kind.

pashto: who د خلکو د پاره دی.
څوک؟ I. بیا am going to + کار.
english: Who? I. Then am going to + the action.

pashto: whose → ملکیت: دا هغه هلک دی چې سایکل یې غلا شو.
english: Whose → possession: He is the boy whose bike was stolen.

pashto: که مهرباني وکړې کړکۍ به خلاصه کړې؟
english: Would you mind opening the window?

pashto: Would you mind…? په ادب دی.
پرون ما له خپلو د تره زامنو سره فټبال ___.
english: Yesterday I ___ football with my cousins.

pashto: پرون زه خپلې نیا ته ورغلم.
yesterday تېر وخت دی. play ته -ed ورزیات کړئ.
english: Yesterday is in the past. Add -ed to play.

pashto: تاسو مخکې د سفر پلان جوړ کړی. څه به ووایئ؟
english: You already planned a trip. What do you say?

pashto: سر دې درد کوي. ته ___ ارام وکړې.
english: You have a headache. You ___ rest.

pashto: ته باید اوبه وڅښې. په سور څراغ باید ودرېږې. کېدی شي وروسته باران وشي.
english: You should drink water. You must stop at a red light. It might rain later.

pashto: په ټولګي کې باید ټیلیفون ونه کاروې.
english: You shouldn’t use your phone in class.

pashto: zero: که اوبه 100°C ته ګرمې کړې، ایشېږي. (حقیقتونه)
english: Zero: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils. (facts)
